About Our Company

Exaware provides end-to-end routing and switching solutions for data center and telecom/service provider networks. The solution delivers field-proven, tested, and preconfigured systems while significantly reducing TCO through the use of open platforms and the economics of open hardware and software.

AS FEATURED IN Forbes

How Disaggregated Routing Strengthens Network Security

The deployment of a traditional wide area network (WAN) is rooted in a vertically-integrated topology, where devices like routers and switches are proprietary hardware appliances with bundled software. While this approach has proven its mettle over the years, it’s increasingly evident that in our dynamic digital era, marked by technological advancements and evolving cyber threats, it lacks the flexibility needed for customization...

“I use Exaware routing system on my peering points, where connectivity is critical and I am satisfied about the performance. Paul Wollner

CEO at Africa on Cloud
